name: separator
title: Separator
description: A structural rule (2, 4 or 8px) spanning its host box, horizontal or vertical, with a seek-safe progress reveal in muted grey or brand red. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="separator": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Orientation
variables.description: Which way the rule runs, and so which way the reveal travels.

variables.label: Thickness
variables.description: Size of the rule across its short edge, from a 2px hairline to an 8px bar.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Colour of the revealed fill: neutral grey, or the reel brand red.
